az_retry() {
  local attempt delay=2
  for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    if command az "$@"; then return 0; fi
    if [[ "$attempt" == 5 ]]; then return 1; fi
    echo "Azure call failed (${attempt}/5); retrying in ${delay}s..." >&2
    sleep "$delay"
    delay=$((delay * 2))
  done
}

echo
echo "Open ${verification_uri} and enter code: ${user_code}"
echo 'Sign in as the account that can use Security Copilot.'

export COPILOT_DELEGATED_CLIENT_ID="$client_id"
export COPILOT_REFRESH_TOKEN_VAULT_NAME="$vault_name"
az_retry deployment group create --name 'copilot-triage-delegated-observe-20260906' --resource-group "$resource_group" --parameters "$script_dir/main.bicepparam" --query properties.outputs -o json

echo
echo 'Delegated Graph authorization is stored in Key Vault and the observe-only playbook is deployed.'
echo 'No incident status or severity can be changed by this workflow.'

grant_json="$(az_retry rest --method get --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals/${app_sp_id}/oauth2PermissionGrants" -o json | jq --arg resource "$graph_sp_id" --arg principal "$user_object_id" '[.value[] | select(.resourceId==$resource and .principalId==$principal and .consentType=="Principal")][0] // {}')"
grant_id="$(jq -r '.id // empty' <<<"$grant_json")"
existing_scopes="$(jq -r '.scope // empty' <<<"$grant_json")"
if [[ " ${existing_scopes} " != *" ${copilot_scope} "* ]]; then
  combined_scopes="$(printf '%s %s' "$existing_scopes" "$copilot_scope" | xargs)"
  if [[ -z "$grant_id" ]]; then
    grant_body="$(jq -n --arg client "$app_sp_id" --arg principal "$user_object_id" --arg resource "$graph_sp_id" --arg scope "$combined_scopes" '{clientId:$client,consentType:"Principal",principalId:$principal,resourceId:$resource,scope:$scope}')"
    az_retry rest --method post --url 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants' --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "$grant_body" -o none
  else
    grant_body="$(jq -n --arg scope "$combined_scopes" '{scope:$scope}')"
    az_retry rest --method patch --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants/${grant_id}" --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "$grant_body" -o none
  fi
fi

az_retry keyvault secret set --vault-name "$vault_name" --name "$secret_name" --file "$refresh_file" -o none

app_sp_id="$(az_retry ad sp list --filter "appId eq '${client_id}'" --query '[0].id' -o tsv)"
if [[ -z "$app_sp_id" ]]; then
  app_sp_id="$(az_retry ad sp create --id "$client_id" --query id -o tsv)"
fi

File: sentinel-playbooks/copilot-observe/authorize-graph-device-code.sh

subscription_id='7d8bc1a3-741d-40ab-916f-a209b0507a47'
tenant_id='24b7f14d-802a-417e-aa6b-4e5d9be6700b'
resource_group='SpecRecon-Demo-RG'
location='uksouth'
workflow_name='specrecon-copilot-triage-observe'
vault_name='specreconcp0507a47'
secret_name='security-copilot-refresh-token'
app_name='specrecon-copilot-delegated-playbook'
graph_app_id='00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000'
copilot_scope='SecurityCopilotWorkspaces.ReadWrite.All'
copilot_scope_id='206291b0-2167-47a7-a640-6cdc1df710ba'
script_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

deadline=$((SECONDS + expires_in))
while (( SECONDS < deadline )); do
  sleep "$interval"
  http_code="$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$token_file" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    --request POST "https://login.microsoftonline.com/${tenant_id}/oauth2/v2.0/token" \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
    --data-urlencode 'grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code' \
    --data-urlencode "client_id=${client_id}" \
    --data-urlencode "device_code=${device_code}")"
  if [[ "$http_code" == 200 ]]; then break; fi
  error_code="$(jq -r '.error // "unknown_error"' "$token_file")"
  if [[ "$error_code" == authorization_pending ]]; then continue; fi
  if [[ "$error_code" == slow_down ]]; then interval=$((interval + 5)); continue; fi
  jq -r '(.error // "token_error") + ": " + (.error_description // "No description")' "$token_file" >&2
  exit 1
done

scope="openid offline_access https://graph.microsoft.com/${copilot_scope}"
device_file="$(mktemp)"
token_file="$(mktemp)"
refresh_file="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$device_file" "$token_file" "$refresh_file"' EXIT
chmod 600 "$device_file" "$token_file" "$refresh_file"

# This lab uses a Consumption Logic App whose outbound addresses aren't stable
# enough for a single firewall rule. Data-plane access still requires an Entra
# token and an explicit vault access policy.
if ! az_retry keyvault show --name "$vault_name" --resource-group "$resource_group" -o none 2>/dev/null; then
  az_retry keyvault create --name "$vault_name" --resource-group "$resource_group" --location "$location" --enable-rbac-authorization false -o none
fi
"$script_dir/fix-keyvault-network.sh" >/dev/null
az_retry keyvault set-policy --name "$vault_name" --object-id "$user_object_id" --secret-permissions get list set -o none

refresh_token="$(jq -r '.refresh_token // empty' "$token_file")"
if [[ -z "$refresh_token" ]]; then
  echo 'No refresh token was issued before the device code expired.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s' "$refresh_token" >"$refresh_file"
unset refresh_token

curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
  --request POST "https://login.microsoftonline.com/${tenant_id}/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode" \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  --data-urlencode "client_id=${client_id}" \
  --data-urlencode "scope=${scope}" >"$device_file"

workflow_principal_id="$(az_retry resource show --resource-group "$resource_group" --name "$workflow_name" --resource-type 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows' --query identity.principalId -o tsv)"
az_retry keyvault set-policy --name "$vault_name" --object-id "$workflow_principal_id" --secret-permissions get set -o none

az_retry account set --subscription "$subscription_id"
user_object_id="$(az_retry ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)"
graph_sp_id="$(az_retry ad sp show --id "$graph_app_id" --query id -o tsv)"

verification_uri="$(jq -r .verification_uri "$device_file")"
user_code="$(jq -r .user_code "$device_file")"
device_code="$(jq -r .device_code "$device_file")"
interval="$(jq -r '.interval // 5' "$device_file")"
expires_in="$(jq -r '.expires_in // 900' "$device_file")"

export AZURE_CONFIG_DIR="${AZURE_CONFIG_DIR:-/tmp/azuregoat-azcfg-20260905}"
export DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR="${DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR:-/tmp/bicep}"

app_json="$(az_retry ad app list --filter "displayName eq '${app_name}'" --query '[0]' -o json)"
app_object_id="$(jq -r '.id // empty' <<<"$app_json")"
client_id="$(jq -r '.appId // empty' <<<"$app_json")"
if [[ -z "$app_object_id" ]]; then
  create_body="$(jq -n --arg name "$app_name" --arg graph "$graph_app_id" --arg scope "$copilot_scope_id" '{displayName:$name,signInAudience:"AzureADMyOrg",isFallbackPublicClient:true,publicClient:{redirectUris:["https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient"]},requiredResourceAccess:[{resourceAppId:$graph,resourceAccess:[{id:$scope,type:"Scope"}]}]}')"
  app_json="$(az_retry rest --method post --url 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications' --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "$create_body" -o json)"
  app_object_id="$(jq -r .id <<<"$app_json")"
  client_id="$(jq -r .appId <<<"$app_json")"
else
  update_body="$(jq -n --arg graph "$graph_app_id" --arg scope "$copilot_scope_id" '{isFallbackPublicClient:true,publicClient:{redirectUris:["https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient"]},requiredResourceAccess:[{resourceAppId:$graph,resourceAccess:[{id:$scope,type:"Scope"}]}]}')"
  az_retry rest --method patch --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications/${app_object_id}" --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "$update_body" -o none
fi
